title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-08-28
lineage: SBD > ?? > R > PCM > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Muddy, low‑fidelity soundboard capture of a fiery August ’68 set featuring a stellar Dark Star and a soaring Eleven.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with high energy – a beautiful Dark Star, a ripping Eleven, tight St. Stephen and an uplifting Lovelight – though Death Don't Have No Mercy falls flat. Unfortunately the recording is badly processed, muddy and low‑volume, making careful listening difficult despite its historical value.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (around 4/5) while recording quality is heavily criticized (around 2/5). Weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields ~3.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy, over‑processed sound with excessive noise reduction and EQ; low volume; sounds like a broadcast copy; overall listenable but far below archival standards.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A single set that opens with high energy, builds momentum through Dark Star and Eleven, briefly dips on Death Don't Have No Mercy, then recovers with Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as flying through the Eleven at mach speed and delivering a nice solo behind Pigpen's rap on Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for staying close behind Jerry during the Eleven, providing strong support.
